# i-Run

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

French online specialist in running, trail, fitness and hiking gear, founded in 2007 and based in Toulouse, with over 200 brands and shops in several French cities. Its delivery page lists metropolitan France, overseas departments and territories and many European countries, with in-store pickup.

*ES:* Especialista francés online en running, trail, fitness y senderismo, fundado en 2007 y con sede en Toulouse, con más de 200 marcas y tiendas en varias ciudades francesas. Su página de entregas indica Francia metropolitana, departamentos y territorios de ultramar y numerosos países europeos, con retiro en tienda.
